# Graph compose send tests assert UI flow and a mock message Subject

The new Graph tasks reuse toolbar, menu and accelerator-key scenarios. The checked helpers wait for compose-window closure and assert that the mock lastSentMessage contains the generated Subject; menu availability and warning-preference transitions have separate assertions. The File-menu task has an explicit macosx skip. These are direct UI/mock assertions, not checks of every MIME byte, Bcc, DSN, FCC, TLS or native recipient delivery. The owned Graph server definition covers plain HTTP; no SSL definition is added here. The review explanation remains separate historical context. No compose or Graph test was run here.

Scope: Compose Graph task wrappers and shared helper coverage.
